teacher_tokens: One source-native A answer on the exact source reasoning prefix, source_reasoning and answer_large task streams, max4096 answer tokens, retain EOS/caps/errors with no quality filtering.
teacher_distributions: Frozen native receiver conditioned on the exact source prompt, reasoning, closing-think bridge and source answer tokens. No hidden labels or tests.
ordinary_continuation: For each actual answer window, include every preceding teacher-forced answer token in both source and native receiver caches, map at the window start, differentiate receiver predictions at the original absolute positions.
natural_handoff_boundary: Map the entire saved prefix once before closing-think; differentiate through every intervening closing/answer token to the declared prediction positions.
history_recomputation: Complete saved source prefix is recomputed in512-token chunks for both frozen models. No cropping, position resets, new user turn, task replacement, resampling, or post-EOS fabrication.
short_answer_policy: Keep exact anchors. Each of four buckets walks the same seeded full-cohort task permutation; valid positions contribute and the next fixed history supplies missing positions. Accumulate gradients with one history in memory. No duplicate task-position within an update; no shifted windows/padding/post-EOS positions. Stop if fewer than eight distinct positions exist globally in a declared window.
schedule: Identical objective-independent schedule and exact initial weights for the two first-seed objectives. Retain all histories and audit per-task missing windows and examples per update.
validation: Common full-boundary native-receiver KL at all actual positions within the declared windows for both objectives. Equal mean over32 validation tasks; report prediction counts and unavailable positions. No candidate-specific validation objective.

initialization.position_selection: Unique rounded linspace over the complete prefix
initialization.keys: Inverse source and receiver RoPE before affine ridge fit; receiver RoPE at unchanged absolute positions after mapping

checkpoint_selection: At most two validated checkpoints with step>=256 per objective, ordered by common validation KL then earlier step. At most four first-seed candidates enter all40 development cases; select passes, then source-inclusive latency, then earlier step. Hard-capped training below256 has no eligible candidate.
checkpoint_resume: Immutable mapper-only checkpoints are backed up. Exact optimizer resumption is not implemented; a partial worker cannot silently restart.
execution_gates: Verified full fixed development baseline/cap gates
Fresh native controls through32768 on everyworker
Exact fixed visible task membership, code and history identities
